parts.label: a
parts.technique: find intersection point of two vector lines
parts.reason: Intersection of lines given as vector equations (r = a + λb) is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers.

parts.label: b

parts.reason: Scalar (dot) product and angle between lines is explicitly excluded.

parts.label: c

parts.reason: Depends on X found in part (a), which is out of spec; the part only makes sense after that out-of-spec result.

parts.label: d

parts.reason: Requires vector perpendicularity (dot product) which is explicitly excluded, and also depends on angle from (b).

parts.label: e

parts.reason: Depends on AX found in part (c), which itself depends on the out-of-spec intersection point X.
